summary.title: Chart selection moved to meal row
changes: Selection readout appears in the meal row instead of a floating card, so it no longer covers chart data.
Selection time is shown on the chart x-axis under the indicator instead of inside the readout.
Scrubbing no longer re-lays the chart and selection markers stay aligned during pinches and drags.
The readout briefly persists across small data gaps instead of flickering back to live IOB/COB while scrubbing.
The readout uses a glass-styled compact row and shows glucose, smoothed value, and IOB/COB inline.
